title: Tenant-tagged replication routing with legal-hold and retention gates
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement a tenant-aware replication controller for analytics pipelines that enforces per-tenant residency preferences, legal-hold tags, and retention gating. The controller should attach residency metadata at ingest, evaluate routing policies (SLA/latency vs. residency), and apply selective replication + retention masks so that tenants with strict residency or legal-hold requirements never have their data replicated outside allowed regions. The work spans the console backend routing layer, pipeline replication service, audit log surfaces, and an ops-friendly rollout path.
acceptance_criteria: Ingress events can carry tenant residency metadata and legal-hold flags and are persisted to analytics topic without schema change
Replication controller evaluates per-tenant policy and rejects or routes replication targets according to allowed regions list
Legal-hold flag sets retention to indefinite and prevents auto-deletion and cross-region replication until cleared
Replication path includes throttles and backpressure so latency-sensitive tenants are prioritized without violating residency rules
Audit trail exists for every cross-region replication decision (tenant, reason, decision, timestamp), visible in Console logs and exportable for compliance
E2E tests simulate mixed-residency workloads and validate no tenant data leaves allowed regions during canary rollout
Migration/rollout runbook documented with metrics thresholds and rollback criteria
tasks: Spec: policy language for residency + legal-hold + retention masks (PM/Compliance)
Schema: add lightweight tenant_residency and legal_hold fields to analytics event envelope
Routing: extend console backend replication router to consult residency policy store
Pipeline: add selective-replicator module that applies retention masks and throttles
Auditing: append replication decisions to immutable audit topic and Console UI endpoint
Testing: integration harness across eu-west-1, us-east-1, ap-southeast-1 with synthetic tenants
Rollout: phased canary by tenant size, monitor cross-region replication rate and blocked-events metric
Docs: Confluence runbook, public FAQ for customers about residency constraints
